shell_commands:
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git branch --show-current
git status --short
sed -n '1,240p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts
sed -n '1,220p' specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md
cat .lore/test-commands.yml"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "cat package.json
sed -n '1,160p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts
rg --files src/orchestration/tools | head
rg -n 'specs/|validated by|@spec|spec:' src/orchestration --glob '*test.ts' | head -60
ls scripts/spec-links"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,180p' scripts/lore-list-tests.mjs
sed -n '1,120p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts
rg -n 'specs/.+#|specs/' src --glob '*test.ts' | head -40
cat tsconfig.json"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,170p' scripts/check-spec-links.mjs
sed -n '1,140p' scripts/check-spec-anchor-names.mjs
sed -n '1,100p' src/types/ai.ts
cat CHANGELOG.md | head -40
rg --files -g 'AGENTS.md' -g '*tdd-loop*' ."

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "node --input-type=module -e \"import {readFileSync} from 'node:fs'; import {segmentStatements} from '@re-cinq/eslint-plugin-re-lint/spec/spec-segment.js'; const s=[...segmentStatements(readFileSync('specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md','utf8'))]; s.forEach((x,i)=>console.log(i+1,x.line,x.text.slice(0,90)))\"
rg -n 'ajv|\"version\"' package.json package-lock.json | head -15
rg -n 'repoint-spec-anchors' scripts/repoint-spec-anchors.mjs | head"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts scripts/lore-list-tests.mjs specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md CHANGELOG.md .lore/dod.md package.json package-lock.json'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git diff --stat
git diff -- .lore/dod.md src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts scripts/lore-list-tests.mjs
nl -ba src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts | head -10
nl -ba src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts | sed -n '12,20p;42,49p;90,97p;108,115p'
git status --short"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git add .lore/dod.md CHANGELOG.md package.json package-lock.json scripts/lore-list-tests.mjs specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts
git commit -m "Validate required tool input before execution"'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main
git merge origin/main'
